company.name: Emidat
company.tagline: Climate-Native Product Management: Create and turn environmental product data (EPDs, LCAs, DPPs) into business value.
company.description:
Climate-Native Product Management - We make it a business value to produce and provide sustainable materials.

The Emidat Platform enables automated generation and distribution of lifecycle assessments (LCAs), environmental product declarations (EPDs) and digital product passports (DPPs). This helps material manufacturers to fulfil customer demands, differentiate their product and be ready for upcoming regulation (e.g. EU CPR).

With Emidat, material manufacturers:
- Reduce cost and time for generating EPDs / LCAs by over 70%
- One license - unlimited product profiles through our third party verified platform
- Save time on data collection and text writing based on AI

The Emidat database consists of environmental data on over 150k construction products and can be accessed via API and UI.
